scripts.dev:native:live: SLINT_LIVE_PREVIEW=1 cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p ovrley_ui --bin ovrley --features live-preview
scripts.showcase:native: cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p ovrley_ui --features dev-windows --example showcase
scripts.test:native-ui: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p ovrley_app -p ovrley_ui -p ovrley_services -p ovrley_mcp --features ovrley_ui/dev-windows
scripts.benchmark:transparent: cd src-tauri && cargo run -p ovrley_core --bin benchmark_transparent --
scripts.benchmark:composite: cd src-tauri && cargo run -p ovrley_core --bin benchmark_composite --
scripts.benchmark:widget-rate: cd src-tauri && cargo run -p ovrley_core --bin benchmark_widget_rate --
